litematicafastmove.config.comment.fastMo: Master switch for LitematicaFastMove (separate placement meshes, instant moving, deferred WorldSchematic updates).
litematicafastmove.config.prettyName.fas: Fast Move: Take Over All Placements
litematicafastmove.config.comment.fastMo:
If true, every placement is rendered with its own mesh.
If false, only placements at least as large as 'Large Placement Volume' are.

Placements with at least this many blocks (W*H*L) defer rewriting the schematic world until movement stops; their mesh is streamed too.
Also the take-over threshold when 'Take Over All Placements' is off.
Run the Schematic Verifier scan on worker threads, reading the schematic directly instead of the schematic world.
How long a large placement must stay still before the deferred schematic world update is committed.
Time constant of the movement interpolation. Larger is smoother but laggier, 0 disables it.
Moves longer than this many blocks are not interpolated.
Maximum mesh data uploaded to the GPU per frame. Remaining data is uploaded on later frames.
Maximum time spent creating GPU buffers per frame.
litematicafastmove.config.prettyName.fas: Fast Move: Translucent Resorts per Frame
litematicafastmove.config.comment.fastMo: Maximum number of translucent sections re-sorted per frame.
A translucent section is re-sorted once the camera moved this many blocks relative to it.
Time limit per client tick for merging verifier results, counted from the start of the tick.
Number of mesh builder threads, 0 = automatic (CPU cores / 4). Takes effect immediately.
Number of verifier scan threads, 0 = automatic (CPU cores - 1). Takes effect immediately.

Draw fading boxes on placement mesh sections being processed.
Amber = rebuild queued, green = rebuilt mesh applied, gray = skipped (real world air before and after), blue = full rebuild of the whole placement.
How long each debug box stays visible while fading out.

Mesh builds are split into batches of this many 16x16x16 sections, nearest to the camera first, and spread over all builder threads.
Smaller batches show results sooner; rebuilt sections appear batch by batch.

After a placement is moved, wait this long before drawing it at the new position. Moving it again within that window restarts the wait, so the intermediate positions are never rendered and their rebuilds are skipped.
litematicafastmove.config.prettyName.fas: Fast Move: Stream Sections per Frame
litematicafastmove.config.comment.fastMo:
Sections submitted for building per frame.
Lower values stay smoother, the placement shows up more slowly.
Sections allowed to build at the same time.

Sections kept on the GPU.
0 means unlimited (default); with a limit, sections past it are not built and distant parts stay missing.
litematicafastmove.config.prettyName.fas: Fast Move: Stream Large Placements Only
litematicafastmove.config.comment.fastMo:
Off: every taken-over placement is streamed section by section.
On: only placements at least the large-placement volume are streamed, the rest are built in one go.

While a placement is dragged, only the mesh this many chunks around the player is rebuilt; the rest waits until you stop and is then filled in by view distance.
A larger radius shows nearby changes sooner but costs more CPU while moving; 0 disables it.
